method.method_draft: Read the image as four nested heart regions with alternating colors: the outermost heart is shaded pink, the next smaller heart is white, the next smaller heart is shaded pink, and the smallest heart is white. From the text, take the four heart areas as 1, 4, 9, and 16 cm², assigned from smallest to largest by nesting. Compute the shaded pink area as the outer pink band plus the inner pink band: (16 - 9) + (4 - 1) = 7 + 3 = 10 cm².
